input.prompt:
Context: in the AMSteel_Quote repo (C:\Users\mmazur\source\repos\AMSteel_Quote), commit 4dbf702 (which I made) replaced the repo's finance_calculator_deployed/nextjs_space with its current on-disk state. That disk state reflects a component swap that Abacus's DeepAgent did locally on 2026-07-07 during a "role/admin panel" integration — it's not something I did, I just committed what was already on disk. During that swap, several old components were deleted and replaced by new ones covering the same UI areas. I already found and fixed ONE silent regression this way: the old app/_components/calculator-panel.tsx had a "sheet weight" display (thickness × width × length × 7.85 / 1e9, in tons) right under the dimension inputs, which never made it into the new components/Calculator.tsx. I restored it.

Your job: check whether Abacus dropped any OTHER functionality during that same swap, across the other three component pairs. Do NOT modify any files — investigation and reporting only.

The four swapped pairs (old → new), get old content via `git show 4dbf702^:<path>` from that repo:
1. app/_components/calculator-panel.tsx → components/Calculator.tsx (I already audited the sheet-weight loss; you should still double check the rest of this file pair for other drops I may have missed — surcharge rows, toggles, warnings, edit/duplicate item flows, etc.)
2. app/_components/header.tsx + app/_components/main-client.tsx → components/Navigation.tsx + app/page.tsx (+ contexts/LanguageContext.tsx / lib/lang-context.tsx)
3. app/_components/offers-panel.tsx + app/offers/offers-client.tsx → app/offers/page.tsx
4. app/login/login-client.tsx → app/login/page.tsx

Known INTENTIONAL differences — do NOT flag these as regressions:
- lib/auth-options.ts and lib/prisma.ts were deleted (NextAuth/Prisma are documented as intentionally dormant; active auth is JWT via lib/auth.ts)
- New role/admin-panel features (junior/senior/admin workflow, /admin/*, /senior pages, approve/reject/submit/send endpoints) are NEW additions from the same integration, not replacements of anything — ignore these entirely, they're not part of this audit
- migrations/ restructuring, package-lock.json addition — not relevant
- lib/calc-data.ts (grade tables & surcharge formulas) was NOT touched/deleted in this commit — both old and new calculator components import from the same lib/calc-data.ts, so that shared logic is not a risk area; you don't need to re-verify formulas that live there, just confirm both old and new actually call the same functions from it for a given feature (e.g. if old called some helper from calc-data.ts that new never calls, that's still worth flagging).

For each of the 4 pairs: read the full old file(s) via git show, read the full current equivalent file(s), and systematically check whether every distinct piece of UI/functionality in the old file (buttons, computed values, conditional displays, form fields, event handlers, validations, localStorage/session handling, keyboard shortcuts, etc.) has a real equivalent in the new code — not just similar-looking, actually equivalent behavior. Pay special attention to small computed/derived-value displays (like the sheet weight was) since those are easy to silently drop during a rewrite — they don't show up as "missing features" at a glance, just missing numbers.

Report back a concrete, evidence-based list. For each finding: which old file/line has the feature, confirmation (via Grep) that no equivalent exists anywhere in the new file, and a one-line description of what a user would notice missing. Rank by confidence (confirmed absent vs. "couldn't find it but the new code is different enough I'm not 100% sure"). If you find nothing beyond what's already fixed, say so plainly — don't manufacture findings. Keep the report tight — a list, not prose essays per item.

content.text:
**Task:** Audit the 4 old/new component pairs from the 2026-07-07 Abacus swap for silently-dropped functionality (beyond the sheet-weight bug already fixed).

## Findings, ranked by confidence

**1. CONFIRMED, HIGH SEVERITY — "Edit item" (✏️) in the zestawienie/summary table no longer restores a line item's surcharge toggles.**
- Old: `handleEditItem` (`app/_components/calculator-panel.tsx:307-357`) restores ~25 fields from `item.inputs` — certificate, coating, CR/HDG protection/packaging/surface/weld, all 8 SSC toggles, margin%, extra, transport.
- New: `editItem` (`components/Calculator.tsx:469-482`) restores only 8 fields: type, thickness, width, length, grade, pglBase, tons, isCoilMode.
- Root cause: the `ZestawienieItem` interface (`Calculator.tsx:29-45`) only stores aggregated totals (`sumaHuta`, `sumaSSC`, `marza`, `finalPrice`) — it never captures the individual toggle selections per item, unlike old `OrderItem.inputs` which snapshotted everything.
- Impact: clicking ✏️ on a saved row silently leaves all surcharge toggles at whatever the calculator's live state happens to be (not that row's actual config). Clicking "UPDATE ITEM" without manually re-selecting every toggle **overwrites the row with a wrong recalculated price**. This is a pricing-integrity bug, not cosmetic. Old code also had an "EDITING ITEM BANNER" (item #, grade, Cancel button) signaling this was in progress — that's gone too, so there's no visual warning either.

**2. CONFIRMED, MEDIUM SEVERITY — saved-offers list lost the per-item expand/preview.**
- Old: `offers-panel.tsx:26-28,162-293` — clicking a row expands it to show each line item (grade, dims, price) via `toggleExpand`.
- New: `app/offers/page.tsx` only shows an aggregate `getOfferItemCount(offer)` (line 451); grepped for expand/detail/view — nothing.
- Impact: can't preview an offer's contents from the list anymore; only way in is Edit (jumps into the calculator) or Export PDF.

**3. LOW SEVERITY, cosmetic — logged-in user's email no longer shown.**
- Old header (`header.tsx:79-83`) showed `session.user.email` next to logout. Grepped all new per-page headers (Calculator, offers, senior) — logout/dark-mode/language toggle all present, email display isn't.

**4. Likely intentional, flagging only — login screen lost its dark/light toggle.**
- Old `login-client.tsx` had a theme toggle; new `app/page.tsx` only has the language selector. But the new login page also switched to fully hardcoded dark colors (not CSS vars), so it's dark-only by design now — reads as a deliberate simplification, not an oversight.

**Not regressions (confirmed intentional / correctly migrated):**
- Public signup tab on login screen is gone — matches the documented admin-only signup decision.
- `main-client.tsx`'s NextAuth-session tab-based SPA → real routes (`/calculator`, `/offers`, `/senior`, `/admin/*`) is the intentional role-based restructure. Header controls (logout/language/dark-mode) got redistributed into each page rather than lost — duplicated per-page, not missing (code-smell, not a bug).
- `dupItem`/duplicate-in-table clones the stored aggregate row directly, no recompute needed — unaffected by finding #1.

**One correction to my brief's assumption:** the new `Calculator.tsx` doesn't actually import from `lib/calc-data.ts` at all — it uses `lib/calculatorData.ts` (from the separate finance_calculator/ merge). This dual-data-file situation is already tracked in STAN_PROJEKTU.md as a known duplication issue, so I didn't chase formula-level parity between the two — out of scope here, but worth knowing finding #1 sits in the `calculatorData.ts`-backed component, not `calc-data.ts`.
